payload.instruction: Move the book behind the flower
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the book visibly positioned behind the flower, with the flower in front of it?
node.criteria: Pass if the image shows the flower in front of and occluding the book in a way that establishes the book is behind it. Fail if the image clearly shows the book is not behind the flower. Unknown if the relative depth or occlusion cannot be determined from the image.
node.binding: Assess only the book’s and flower’s relative positions and visible occlusion in the edited image.

node_traces.evidence: In the edited image, the book and flowers are separate and do not overlap; neither flower occludes the book to establish that it is behind one.

fulfillment: The node’s absent/no conclusion is supported: in the edited image the book and flowers remain spatially separate, with no overlap or occlusion establishing the book behind a flower. The flowers’ changed appearance/count is unrelated progress and must not satisfy the placement criterion. Preserve the rubric’s partial-progress distinction: assess the requested book–flower relation in each saved check, and only count a check as progress if it shows a genuine move toward that relation; retain unknown when evidence is unresolved. The current traces are valid and highly confident, with no transport or dependency failure, so avoid changing the criterion merely to chase the reference label. For typed edits, make the binding explicitly track the same book and a flower across source and edited snapshots, and distinguish visible depth/occlusion from mere proximity or unrelated object changes.
s2: The current fail is well supported: the edited image shows the book and flowers still separate, with no visible overlap or occlusion placing the book behind a flower; the flowers’ changed appearance/count is unrelated. Keep the partial-progress criterion and unknown option. Improve the binding so it identifies the same book and a flower across source and edited snapshots, and evaluates change in their relative position/depth rather than treating proximity or unrelated edits as progress. Do not alter the criterion just to match the reference label; the trace is valid, high-confidence, and has no transport or dependency failure.
